hardcodedAnthropicKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedGitHubPat.title: Hardcoded GitHub PAT
hardcodedGitHubPat.description: Hardcoded GitHub PAT found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedGitHubPat.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedGoogleKey.title: Hardcoded Google API key
hardcodedGoogleKey.description: Hardcoded Google API key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedGoogleKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedAWSKey.title: Hardcoded AWS access key
hardcodedAWSKey.description: Hardcoded AWS access key found in {file}. Credential exposed in source code and git history.
hardcodedAWSKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately. Add pre-commit secret scanner.

hardcodedCred.description: Credential assigned as literal at line {line}.

jwtNoneAlgorithm.title: JWT 'none' algorithm
jwtNoneAlgorithm.recommendation: Specify allowed algorithms (HS256, RS256). Never accept 'none'.

weakMd5.title: Weak MD5 hashing
weakMd5.recommendation: Migrate to bcrypt/argon2 with work factor >= 12.

sqlInjection.title: Potential SQL Injection
sqlInjection.description: User input interpolated into SQL query.
sqlInjection.recommendation: Use parameterized queries. Never interpolate user input.

pathTraversal.title: Potential Path Traversal
pathTraversal.recommendation: Validate paths with path.resolve(). Verify within allowed dir.

ssrf.title: Potential SSRF
ssrf.recommendation: Validate URLs against allowlist. Block internal IPs.

unsafeEval.title: Unsafe eval() usage
unsafeEval.recommendation: Replace with JSON.parse or safe alternative.

openRedirect.title: Potential Open Redirect
openRedirect.recommendation: Validate against allowlist of trusted domains.

hardcodedStripeKey.title: Hardcoded Stripe live key
hardcodedStripeKey.description: Stripe live secret key {sk_live_*} found in source.
hardcodedStripeKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate immediately.

hardcodedSlackToken.title: Hardcoded Slack token
hardcodedSlackToken.description: Slack bot/user token exposed in code.
hardcodedSlackToken.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate.

hardcodedTwilioSid.title: Hardcoded Twilio SID
hardcodedTwilioSid.description: Twilio account SID (AC*) committed to source.
hardcodedTwilioSid.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate.

hardcodedTelegramToken.title: Hardcoded Telegram bot token
hardcodedTelegramToken.description: Telegram bot token exposed in source.
hardcodedTelegramToken.recommendation: Move to env var and revoke the bot token.

hardcodedDiscordToken.title: Hardcoded Discord token
hardcodedDiscordToken.description: Discord bot token committed to source.
hardcodedDiscordToken.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate the token.

hardcodedNpmToken.title: Hardcoded npm token
hardcodedNpmToken.description: npm publish token exposed in source.
hardcodedNpmToken.recommendation: Move to env var and revoke/rotate.

hardcodedSendGridKey.title: Hardcoded SendGrid key
hardcodedSendGridKey.description: SendGrid API key exposed in source.
hardcodedSendGridKey.recommendation: Move to env var and rotate.

hardcodedAzureStorageKey.title: Hardcoded Azure storage key
hardcodedAzureStorageKey.description: Azure storage account key committed to source.
hardcodedAzureStorageKey.recommendation: Move to env var and regenerate.

gcpServiceAccountKey.title: GCP service account key file
gcpServiceAccountKey.description: GCP service_account JSON key file committed to source.
gcpServiceAccountKey.recommendation: Remove from repo, load from secret manager.

postgresUrlWithCreds.title: PostgreSQL URL with embedded credentials
postgresUrlWithCreds.description: Postgres connection string contains a username/password.
postgresUrlWithCreds.recommendation: Use env vars and secret manager; never commit DSNs.

mongoUrlWithCreds.title: MongoDB URL with embedded credentials
mongoUrlWithCreds.recommendation: Use env vars and secret manager.

redisUrlWithCreds.title: Redis URL with embedded credentials
redisUrlWithCreds.recommendation: Use env vars and secret manager.

mysqlUrlWithCreds.title: MySQL URL with embedded credentials
mysqlUrlWithCreds.recommendation: Use env vars and secret manager.

sessionSecretAssignment.title: Session secret hardcoded
sessionSecretAssignment.description: Session/JWT/COOKIE secret assigned as a literal.

basicAuthHeader.title: Basic auth header with credentials
basicAuthHeader.description: Hardcoded Basic Authorization header exposes credentials.
basicAuthHeader.recommendation: Use a token/credential store; never commit Basic auth.

credsInGitUrl.title: Credentials in git remote URL
credsInGitUrl.description: Git URL embeds a username/password or token.
credsInGitUrl.recommendation: Remove creds from URL; use SSH keys or credential helpers.

pythonFStringSql.title: SQL built with Python f-string
pythonFStringSql.description: f-string interpolates values into SQL query.

phpSqlConcat.title: SQL built with PHP string concatenation

javaSqlConcat.title: SQL built with Java string concatenation

goSprintfSql.title: SQL built with fmt.Sprintf
goSprintfSql.description: SQL query assembled via fmt.Sprintf — injection risk.
goSprintfSql.recommendation: Use database/sql placeholders (?) or an ORM.

pythonOsSystem.title: os.system() used
pythonOsSystem.description: os.system runs a shell — command injection risk.
pythonOsSystem.recommendation: Use subprocess.run with a list of args.

pythonSubprocessShell.title: subprocess with shell=True
pythonSubprocessShell.description: shell=True passes the command to a shell.
pythonSubprocessShell.recommendation: Avoid shell=True; pass args as a list.

javaRuntimeExec.title: Runtime.exec() used
javaRuntimeExec.description: Runtime.exec runs a system command — injection risk.
javaRuntimeExec.recommendation: Use ProcessBuilder with an argument list.

phpShellExec.title: Shell command execution in PHP
phpShellExec.recommendation: Validate input; use escapeshellarg or avoid shell calls.

nodeChildProcessExec.title: child_process exec/spawn
nodeChildProcessExec.description: child_process exec/spawn can run shell commands.
nodeChildProcessExec.recommendation: Use execFile with an argument array.

goExecCommand.title: exec.Command() used
goExecCommand.recommendation: Validate input and avoid shell interpolation.

templateInjectionPy.title: Server-side template injection risk
templateInjectionPy.description: render_template_string evaluates template code from input.
templateInjectionPy.recommendation: Never pass user input into template strings.

domInnerHtmlXss.title: Unsafe innerHTML assignment
domInnerHtmlXss.description: Setting innerHTML with dynamic data enables DOM XSS.
domInnerHtmlXss.recommendation: Use textContent or escape/sanitize the value.

domOuterHtmlXss.title: Unsafe outerHTML assignment
domOuterHtmlXss.description: Setting outerHTML with dynamic data enables DOM XSS.
domOuterHtmlXss.recommendation: Avoid outerHTML; use DOM APIs or sanitize.

insertAdjacentHtmlXss.title: Unsafe insertAdjacentHTML
insertAdjacentHtmlXss.description: insertAdjacentHTML parses HTML from dynamic data.
insertAdjacentHtmlXss.recommendation: Sanitize input with DOMPurify before insertion.

documentWriteXss.title: document.write() used
documentWriteXss.recommendation: Avoid document.write; use safe DOM APIs.

vueVHtmlXss.title: v-html directive used
vueVHtmlXss.description: v-html renders raw HTML — XSS risk with user data.
vueVHtmlXss.recommendation: Use template interpolation or sanitize with a library.

angularInnerHtmlXss.title: Angular [innerHTML] binding
angularInnerHtmlXss.recommendation: Use interpolation or sanitize with DomSanitizer.

javascriptHrefXss.title: javascript: URL in href
javascriptHrefXss.description: javascript: URLs execute code — XSS vector.

weakSha1.title: Weak SHA-1 hashing
weakSha1.description: SHA-1 is cryptographically broken for security use.

weakRc4.title: Weak RC4 cipher
weakRc4.description: RC4/ARC4 is broken — allows stream cipher attacks.

weakEcbMode.title: ECB encryption mode
weakEcbMode.description: ECB mode leaks patterns in plaintext.
weakEcbMode.recommendation: Use AES-GCM or CBC with random IV.

hardcodedSalt.title: Hardcoded salt
hardcodedSalt.description: Reusing a fixed salt weakens password hashing.
hardcodedSalt.recommendation: Generate a unique random salt per password.

hardcodedIv.title: Hardcoded IV
hardcodedIv.description: Reusing a fixed IV weakens encryption.
hardcodedIv.recommendation: Use a random IV per encryption.

weakRandomForSecret.title: Weak RNG for security
weakRandomForSecret.description: Math.random() is not cryptographically secure for tokens/OTPs.

pythonWeakRandomForSecret.title: Weak RNG for security (Python)
pythonWeakRandomForSecret.description: random module is not cryptographically secure for secrets.

jwtWeakSecret.title: Weak JWT signing secret
jwtWeakSecret.description: JWT signed with a very short literal secret.
jwtWeakSecret.recommendation: Use a long random secret from env.

cookieNoHttpOnly.title: Cookie without HttpOnly
cookieNoHttpOnly.description: httpOnly:false lets JavaScript read the cookie — XSS risk.
cookieNoHttpOnly.recommendation: Set HttpOnly: true for session cookies.

cookieNoSecure.title: Cookie without Secure flag
cookieNoSecure.description: secure:false sends the cookie over HTTP.

timingUnsafeCompare.title: Non-constant-time comparison
timingUnsafeCompare.description: Comparing hashes/signatures with == leaks timing info.

pickleLoads.title: Unsafe pickle.loads()
pickleLoads.description: pickle.loads can execute arbitrary code on untrusted data.
pickleLoads.recommendation: Use JSON or a safe serialization format.

phpUnserialize.title: Unsafe unserialize()
phpUnserialize.description: unserialize on untrusted data leads to object injection.
phpUnserialize.recommendation: Use JSON or whitelist allowed classes.

javaObjectInputStream.title: Unsafe Java deserialization
javaObjectInputStream.description: ObjectInputStream.readObject on untrusted data — RCE risk.
javaObjectInputStream.recommendation: Use safe formats or validate with a filter.

dotnetBinaryFormatter.title: Unsafe BinaryFormatter
dotnetBinaryFormatter.description: BinaryFormatter deserialization is dangerous on untrusted data.

xxeDtdProcessing.title: XXE — unsafe DTD processing
xxeDtdProcessing.description: Parser is configured to process DTD/external entities.

sqlNoParameterized.title: SQL without parameters (Python)
sqlNoParameterized.recommendation: Use parameter placeholders in the DB driver.

pathTraversalJoin.title: Path traversal in path.join
pathTraversalJoin.description: path.join with request input can escape the base dir.
pathTraversalJoin.recommendation: Resolve and verify the path stays inside the allowed root.

openRedirectGeneric.title: Potential open redirect
openRedirectGeneric.recommendation: Validate the target against an allowlist.

uploadNoSizeLimit.title: File upload without size limit
uploadNoSizeLimit.description: Upload handler lacks a size limit — DoS risk.
uploadNoSizeLimit.recommendation: Set file size/type limits on uploads.

newFunctionEval.title: new Function() used
newFunctionEval.description: new Function compiles and runs arbitrary code.
newFunctionEval.recommendation: Replace with a safe parser or JSON.parse.

curlInsecure.title: Insecure curl options
curlInsecure.description: curl -k / CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER false disables TLS checks.

secretInLogs.title: Secret logged to console
secretInLogs.recommendation: Never log secrets; redact sensitive fields.

hardcodedAdminCreds.title: Hardcoded admin credentials
hardcodedAdminCreds.description: Default admin username/password committed to source.
hardcodedAdminCreds.recommendation: Generate credentials at runtime or via env.

chmod777.title: chmod 777 permissions
chmod777.description: World-writable permissions are a security risk.

sshPrivateKey.title: Embedded SSH private key
sshPrivateKey.description: OpenSSH private key committed to source.
sshPrivateKey.recommendation: Remove the key; use a secrets manager.

mongoNoSQLInjection.title: NoSQL injection risk
mongoNoSQLInjection.description: $where/$regex with user input enables NoSQL injection.
mongoNoSQLInjection.recommendation: Sanitize operators and validate input types.

jwtNoExpiry.title: JWT without expiry
jwtNoExpiry.description: jwt.sign without expiresIn creates never-expiring tokens.

headerInjection.title: Header injection risk
headerInjection.recommendation: Sanitize header values and remove CR/LF.

phpFileInclusion.title: Local/Remote file inclusion
phpFileInclusion.description: include/require with user input allows file inclusion.

execSyncTemplate.title: execSync with template string
execSyncTemplate.description: execSync with a template literal runs shell commands.
execSyncTemplate.recommendation: Use execFile with an argument array.

sqlRawConcatJs.title: SQL built with JS concatenation
sqlRawConcatJs.description: db.query/db.execute with string concatenation — injection risk.

nullDeref.title: Potential null dereference
nullDeref.description: ctx.user accessed without null check at line {line}.

missingDeps.title: Missing useEffect dependency array
missingDeps.description: useEffect without dependency array runs on every render.

asyncStateAfterUnmount.title: Async state update after unmount
asyncStateAfterUnmount.description: async useEffect may set state after unmount.
asyncStateAfterUnmount.recommendation: Use AbortController or a mounted flag.

looseEquality.title: Loose equality (==)
looseEquality.description: == does type coercion, may cause bugs.

consoleLog.title: console.log in production code
consoleLog.recommendation: Remove or replace with a proper logger.

varInsteadOfLetConst.title: var instead of let/const
varInsteadOfLetConst.description: var has function scope, not block scope.

missingAwait.title: Missing await before async call
missingAwait.description: Async function called without await — promise may not resolve.

infiniteLoop.title: Potential infinite loop
infiniteLoop.recommendation: Add a break condition or limit iterations.

unusedVariable.title: Unused variable: {name}
unusedVariable.recommendation: Remove the unused variable or prefix with _ if intentional.

goNilDeref.title: Potential nil dereference
goNilDeref.description: Chained field access on a possibly nil value.

javaNullDeref.title: Potential null dereference
javaNullDeref.description: Chained method call may hit a null object.
javaNullDeref.recommendation: Add null checks or use Optional.

pyAttrUnchecked.title: Unchecked attribute chain
pyAttrUnchecked.description: Chained attribute access may raise AttributeError.
pyAttrUnchecked.recommendation: Guard with getattr/hasattr or optional chaining.

promiseNoCatch.title: Promise without catch
promiseNoCatch.description: Promise chain ends without .catch() — unhandled rejection.

asyncFuncNoAwait.title: Async function without await
asyncFuncNoAwait.description: async keyword adds a promise without benefit.

phpLooseInt.title: Loose comparison with 0
phpLooseInt.description: == 0 matches empty strings and 'false' in PHP.

goStringConcatByte.title: Inefficient []byte conversion
goStringConcatByte.description: Converting to []byte for concatenation is wasteful.
goStringConcatByte.recommendation: Use strings.Builder or byte slice methods.

parseIntNoRadix.title: parseInt without radix
parseIntNoRadix.description: parseInt without radix can parse as octal/hex unexpectedly.

floatEquality.title: Float equality comparison
floatEquality.description: Comparing floats with === is unreliable due to precision.

typeofObjectNull.title: typeof object without null check
typeofObjectNull.description: typeof x === 'object' is true for null.
typeofObjectNull.recommendation: Add x !== null to the condition.

cStrcpy.title: Unsafe strcpy()
cStrcpy.description: strcpy can overflow the destination buffer.

cGets.title: Unsafe gets()
cGets.description: gets() has no bounds checking — classic overflow.
cGets.recommendation: Use fgets() with a size limit.

cSprintf.title: Unsafe sprintf()
cSprintf.description: sprintf can overflow the destination buffer.
cSprintf.recommendation: Use snprintf() with a size limit.

cUnsafeConcat.title: Unsafe strcat()
cUnsafeConcat.description: strcat can overflow the destination buffer.

pyMutableDefault.title: Mutable default argument
pyMutableDefault.recommendation: Use None and create inside the function.

pySwitchMissing.title: Long if/elif chain
pySwitchMissing.description: Multiple if/elif on one value — consider a dict/map.
pySwitchMissing.recommendation: Use a dict lookup or match statement.

jsVarInBlock.title: var inside block scope
jsVarInBlock.description: var leaks out of block scope.

goDeferInLoop.title: defer inside a loop
goDeferInLoop.description: deferred calls accumulate until the function returns.
goDeferInLoop.recommendation: Move defer outside the loop or inline cleanup.

goSliceOutOfRange.title: Potential slice index panic
goSliceOutOfRange.description: Slice indexing with computed index may panic.

assignmentInCondition.title: Assignment inside condition
assignmentInCondition.description: if (x = y) assigns instead of comparing.

resourceNotClosed.title: Resource may not be closed
resourceNotClosed.recommendation: Close the resource in finally or use with/try.

infiniteRecursion.title: Potential infinite recursion
infiniteRecursion.description: Function calls itself without a guard.
infiniteRecursion.recommendation: Add a base case or recursion limit.

sqlNoWhere.title: Destructive query without WHERE
sqlNoWhere.description: DELETE/TRUNCATE without WHERE removes all rows.
sqlNoWhere.recommendation: Add a WHERE clause or a transaction guard.

goIgnoredError.title: Ignored error return
goIgnoredError.description: err from a call is ignored.

staleClosure.title: Stale closure in effect
staleClosure.recommendation: Include the dependency or use a ref.

keyIndexInList.title: Array index used as key
keyIndexInList.description: Using index as key breaks reconciliation on reorder.

dangerousSetState.title: setState inside render path
dangerousSetState.description: setState(this.state) may loop or corrupt state.

onClickInvoke.title: Handler invoked immediately
onClickInvoke.description: onClick={fn()} calls fn at render time.

mutatingProps.title: Mutating props
mutatingProps.description: Assigning to props is an anti-pattern.
mutatingProps.recommendation: Use state or a copy instead.

getDerivedState.title: State updated during render
getDerivedState.description: setState during render can cause re-render loops.
getDerivedState.recommendation: Derive values or move to useEffect.

awaitInMap.title: await inside map callback
awaitInMap.description: await in map is sequential; results also lose ordering.

consoleInProd.title: console.log in production
consoleInProd.description: Debug logging left in production code.

hardcodedLocale.title: Hardcoded locale in formatting
hardcodedLocale.recommendation: Use the app locale or t() helper.

goMapNoCommaOk.title: Map lookup without comma-ok
goMapNoCommaOk.description: Map indexing without the comma-ok idiom can return zero value.
goMapNoCommaOk.recommendation: Use v, ok := m[k] and check ok.

pyReturnNoneAttr.title: Returning possibly-None attribute
pyReturnNoneAttr.description: Chained access on a returned attribute may be None.
pyReturnNoneAttr.recommendation: Guard with an explicit None check.

javaBoxedUnbox.title: Boxed type == comparison
javaBoxedUnbox.description: Comparing boxed Integer/Long with == compares references.

floatingPromise.title: Floating promise
floatingPromise.description: Async call made without await/return — errors unhandled.

setIntervalCallbackSync.title: setInterval without cleanup
setIntervalCallbackSync.description: Recurring timer may leak and keep running.
setIntervalCallbackSync.recommendation: Store the id and clear it when done.

nonAwaitAsyncCall.title: Async call without await
nonAwaitAsyncCall.description: Async handler invoked without awaiting its promise.
nonAwaitAsyncCall.recommendation: Await the call or handle the promise.

cUncheckedBuffer.title: Fixed-size stack buffer
cUncheckedBuffer.description: Fixed char array may overflow on untrusted input.
cUncheckedBuffer.recommendation: Use dynamic allocation or bounded writes.

cIntOverflow.title: Potential integer overflow
cIntOverflow.description: int arithmetic may overflow on large values.
cIntOverflow.recommendation: Use larger types or check bounds.

pyExceptOnException.title: Broad except Exception
pyExceptOnException.description: Catching generic Exception hides real failures.

pyGlobalMutation.title: Global variable mutation
pyGlobalMutation.description: global keyword mutates module state implicitly.

phpComparisonLoose.title: Loose value comparison
phpComparisonLoose.description: == coerces types and can give unexpected matches.

goStringCompareBytes.title: Bytes vs string comparison
goStringCompareBytes.description: Comparing []byte and string mixes types — use string(x) explicitly.

divideByZero.title: Potential division by zero
divideByZero.description: Expression may divide by a zero-valued operand.

duplicateCase.title: Duplicate switch case
duplicateCase.description: Two cases match the same value.

infiniteWhile.title: while(true) loop
infiniteWhile.description: Loop without an exit condition hangs forever.
infiniteWhile.recommendation: Add a break/return or bounded iteration.

missingBreak.title: Missing break in switch
missingBreak.description: Switch case likely falls through without break.

stringConcatPitfall.title: String/number concat pitfall
stringConcatPitfall.description: Mixing strings and numbers with + coerces implicitly.
stringConcatPitfall.recommendation: Use template literals or explicit conversion.

comparingThis.title: Comparing this to another value
comparingThis.description: this is never equal to an arbitrary value.
comparingThis.recommendation: Remove the comparison; it is always false.

lodashFull.title: Entire lodash imported
lodashFull.description: Importing all of lodash ships ~70KB to client.
lodashFull.recommendation: Use 'import debounce from lodash/debounce' or switch to es-toolkit.

underscore.title: underscore imported
underscore.description: underscore adds ~60KB. Use individual lodash/es modules or native JS.
underscore.recommendation: Use individual lodash/es modules or native JS.

rxjsFull.title: Full rxjs import
rxjsFull.description: Importing all of rxjs is huge. Use 'import { map } from rxjs/operators'.

antdFull.title: antd full import without tree-shaking
antdFull.description: antd may bundle unused components. Use babel-plugin-import or individual imports.

barrelFile.title: Barrel file with many re-exports
barrelFile.description: index.ts re-exports many modules — prevents tree-shaking.
barrelFile.recommendation: Split barrel file or use direct imports.

expensiveComputation.title: Expensive computation in render
expensiveComputation.description: Array sort/filter/reduce in render without useMemo.
expensiveComputation.recommendation: Wrap in useMemo with proper dependencies.

handlerNotMemoized.title: Handler not memoized
handlerNotMemoized.description: Function handler created inline and passed to child — causes re-renders.

useStateObjectSpread.title: useState object spread
useStateObjectSpread.description: Spreading state object on every update is wasteful. Use separate useState or useReducer.
useStateObjectSpread.recommendation: Use individual useState hooks or useReducer for complex state.

multipleInlineStyles.title: Multiple inline style objects
multipleInlineStyles.description: Dynamic style objects create new references each render — causes re-renders.
multipleInlineStyles.recommendation: Move static styles to CSS classes or useMemo.

componentNotMemoized.title: Component not wrapped in React.memo
componentNotMemoized.description: Exported component will re-render on every parent render.
componentNotMemoized.recommendation: Wrap component in React.memo() if props are stable.

largeFile.title: Large component file
largeFile.description: Component file has {count} lines — consider splitting.

missingKeyInList.title: Missing key in list render
missingKeyInList.description: React list without key prop causes re-render inefficiency.
missingKeyInList.recommendation: Add key={item.id} to each list item.

manyInlineHandlers.title: Many inline handlers
manyInlineHandlers.description: Multiple inline onClick handlers cause child re-renders.
manyInlineHandlers.recommendation: Extract to useCallback or define outside render.

sequentialAwait.title: Sequential await in loop
sequentialAwait.description: Awaiting inside a loop is sequential — slow for independent operations.

asyncWithoutAwait.title: Async function without await
asyncWithoutAwait.description: Function declared async but doesn't use await — unnecessary overhead.
asyncWithoutAwait.recommendation: Remove async keyword or add await.

consoleLogPerf.title: console.log in production
consoleLogPerf.description: console.log calls in production code waste performance.
consoleLogPerf.recommendation: Remove or use a conditional logger.

evalOrNewFunction.title: eval or new Function
evalOrNewFunction.description: eval() and new Function() are slow and dangerous.
evalOrNewFunction.recommendation: Replace with JSON.parse or a safe parser.

setTimeoutForAnimation.title: setTimeout for animation
setTimeoutForAnimation.description: setTimeout is not synced with refresh rate — use requestAnimationFrame.

heavyComponentNotDynamic.title: Heavy component not dynamically imported
heavyComponentNotDynamic.description: Heavy component imported eagerly — increases initial bundle.

imgInsteadOfNextImage.title: instead of next/image
imgInsteadOfNextImage.description: Using misses automatic optimization, lazy loading, and responsive sizes.

unnecessaryUseClient.title: Unnecessary use client directive
unnecessaryUseClient.description: File has 'use client' but uses no client-only hooks or event handlers.
unnecessaryUseClient.recommendation: Remove 'use client' to enable server rendering.

nPlusOne.title: N+1 query pattern
nPlusOne.description: Database query inside .map() — each iteration hits the DB.
nPlusOne.recommendation: Batch with findMany({ where: { id: { in } } }) or use includes().

unboundedQuery.title: Unbounded query — no pagination
unboundedQuery.description: findMany without take/skip loads all records.

syncFileIo.title: Sync file I/O in request handler

regexpInRender.title: RegExp constructed in render
regexpInRender.description: Creating RegExp in render is expensive.
regexpInRender.recommendation: Move RegExp outside component or useMemo.

setIntervalNoClear.title: setInterval without clearInterval
setIntervalNoClear.description: setInterval started but never cleared — memory leak + zombie callbacks.
setIntervalNoClear.recommendation: Store the id and call clearInterval in useEffect cleanup.

addEventListenerNoRemove.title: addEventListener without removeEventListener
addEventListenerNoRemove.description: Event listener added but never removed — memory leak across re-mounts.

setTimeoutNoClear.title: setTimeout without clearTimeout in effect
setTimeoutNoClear.description: setTimeout in useEffect without cleanup — callback fires after unmount.

subscriptionNoUnsubscribe.title: Subscription not unsubscribed
subscriptionNoUnsubscribe.description: Observable/socket subscription without unsubscribe — leak across remounts.
subscriptionNoUnsubscribe.recommendation: Use takeUntil, or unsubscribe in useEffect cleanup.

dangerouslySetInnerHTMLPerf.title: dangerouslySetInnerHTML used
dangerouslySetInnerHTMLPerf.description: Bypasses React reconciliation and is a XSS vector.
dangerouslySetInnerHTMLPerf.recommendation: Sanitize with DOMPurify or render as React children.

lazyNoSuspense.title: React.lazy without Suspense boundary
lazyNoSuspense.description: Lazy component rendered without Suspense fallback — will throw if not ready.

nestedTernary.title: Nested ternary expressions
nestedTernary.description: Nested ternaries are hard to read and can cause unnecessary re-evaluation.
nestedTernary.recommendation: Refactor to a lookup map, switch, or early returns.

defaultPropObject.title: Object/array default prop value
defaultPropObject.description: Default {} or [] creates a new reference each render — breaks memoization.
defaultPropObject.recommendation: Use null/undefined default or define the constant outside the component.

largeInlineData.title: Large inline data in component
largeInlineData.description: Large array/object literal declared inside component — re-allocated every render.
largeInlineData.recommendation: Move static data outside the component or to a separate module.

useEffectNoDeps.title: useEffect without dependency array
useEffectNoDeps.description: useEffect without a dependency array runs after every render.

manyUseState.title: Many useState hooks for related state
manyUseState.description: {count} useState calls — related state should be consolidated.
manyUseState.recommendation: Use useReducer for related state transitions.

propsToMemoizedChildNotWrapped.title: Props to memoized child not wrapped
propsToMemoizedChildNotWrapped.description: Passing inline handlers to React.memo children defeats memoization.
propsToMemoizedChildNotWrapped.recommendation: Wrap handlers in useCallback with proper deps.

jsonParseInRender.title: JSON.parse in render
jsonParseInRender.description: Parsing JSON in render runs every render — expensive.
jsonParseInRender.recommendation: Parse once outside component or useMemo.

stringConcatInLoop.title: String concat in loop
stringConcatInLoop.description: Building strings with += in a loop is O(n²). Use array.push + join.
stringConcatInLoop.recommendation: Collect into an array and .join() at the end.

layoutThrashing.title: Layout thrashing in loop
layoutThrashing.description: Reading layout properties inside a loop forces sync reflow each iteration.
layoutThrashing.recommendation: Read all layout values first, then mutate.

domQueryInRender.title: DOM query in render
domQueryInRender.description: document.querySelector in render is slow and breaks SSR. Use useRef.
domQueryInRender.recommendation: Use useRef to access DOM nodes.

oN2IndexOf.title: indexOf inside loop (O(n²))
oN2IndexOf.description: indexOf in a loop is quadratic.
oN2IndexOf.recommendation: Use a Set or Map for lookups.

oN2Includes.title: includes inside loop (O(n²))
oN2Includes.description: includes in a loop is quadratic.
oN2Includes.recommendation: Use a Set or Map for lookups.

nestedLoop.title: Nested loops
nestedLoop.description: Nested loops may be O(n²) or worse.
nestedLoop.recommendation: Use indexes/maps or flatten the iteration.

deepCloneJson.title: Deep clone via JSON
deepCloneJson.description: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) is slow and drops functions/undefined.

filterThenMap.title: filter then map traversal
filterThenMap.recommendation: Combine with a flatMap or a single loop.

regexInLoop.title: RegExp constructed in loop
regexInLoop.description: Creating RegExp each iteration is wasteful.
regexInLoop.recommendation: Hoist the RegExp outside the loop.

concatInLoop.title: String concat in loop
concatInLoop.recommendation: Collect into an array and join().

arrayCopyInLoop.title: Array mutation in loop
arrayCopyInLoop.description: push/unshift/splice in a loop rebuilds the array.
arrayCopyInLoop.recommendation: Preallocate or use a single pass.

requestsNoTimeout.title: HTTP request without timeout
requestsNoTimeout.description: requests.get without timeout can hang forever.

fetchNoTimeout.title: fetch without timeout
fetchNoTimeout.recommendation: Wire up AbortController or a timeout.

fetchNoRevalidate.title: fetch without revalidation
fetchNoRevalidate.description: Server fetch caches nothing by default.

sleepInHandler.title: time.sleep in handler
sleepInHandler.recommendation: Use async scheduling or a queue.

callbackInLoop.title: Async callback in loop
callbackInLoop.description: async forEach callbacks overlap and can't be awaited.
callbackInLoop.recommendation: Use a for...of with await or Promise.all.

importD3.title: Full d3 import
importD3.description: Bundling all of d3 is heavy.

importThree.title: Full three.js import
importThree.recommendation: Use tree-shaken imports or dynamic import.

importChartJs.title: Full chart.js import
importChartJs.recommendation: Import only used chart types or use a lighter lib.

importJquery.title: jQuery imported
importJquery.description: jQuery is large and mostly unnecessary in modern JS.
importJquery.recommendation: Use native DOM APIs or a small lib.

importBootstrap.title: Bootstrap imported
importBootstrap.description: Full Bootstrap ships a large CSS/JS bundle.
importBootstrap.recommendation: Import only used components or use CSS variables.

importAxios.title: axios dependency
importAxios.description: axios adds overhead vs native fetch.

inlineFunctionRender.title: Inline function in render
inlineFunctionRender.description: Inline handlers recreate functions each render.
inlineFunctionRender.recommendation: Use useCallback or hoist the function.

dbQueryInLoop.title: DB query inside loop
dbQueryInLoop.description: Query executed repeatedly in a loop.

reactiveQueryNoCache.title: Query without staleTime
reactiveQueryNoCache.description: useQuery without staleTime refetches too often.

globalVariableAccumulate.title: Global array accumulates
globalVariableAccumulate.recommendation: Use a bounded cache or cleanup.

domQueryInLoop.title: DOM query in loop
domQueryInLoop.description: document.querySelector in a loop is slow.

layoutThrashInLoop.title: Layout thrash in loop
layoutThrashInLoop.description: Reading layout in a loop forces reflow.
layoutThrashInLoop.recommendation: Read layout values first, then mutate.

largeArrayLiteral.title: Large inline array literal
largeArrayLiteral.description: Big literal arrays bloat the bundle.
largeArrayLiteral.recommendation: Move to a separate lazy-loaded module.

unboundedCache.title: Unbounded cache growth
unboundedCache.recommendation: Add eviction (LRU) or a size limit.

syncXhr.title: Synchronous XHR
syncXhr.description: Synchronous requests block the UI thread.

localStorageInRender.title: localStorage access in render
localStorageInRender.description: localStorage is synchronous and slow in render.
localStorageInRender.recommendation: Move to useEffect or a state store.
